title: Short Vowel Sounds — A, E, I, O, U
memory_verse: "Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path." — Psalm 119:105 (NIV)
objective: Students will identify and produce short vowel sounds in simple words.
content: Every word has vowels! The vowels are A, E, I, O, and U. Today we will learn their short sounds.
Short A says 'ah' like in 'cat' and 'man.' Short E says 'eh' like in 'red' and 'hen.' Short I says 'ih' like in 'sit' and 'fish.'
Short O says 'ah' like in 'dog' and 'God.' Short U says 'uh' like in 'sun' and 'cup.' These sounds help us read many words in the Bible!
activity: Sort picture cards into five groups by their short vowel sound. Practice reading these CVC (consonant-vowel-consonant) words: cat, bed, pig, log, bus, map, pet, kid, box, rug.
discussion: Can you think of a Bible word with a short vowel sound?
What sound does the letter 'a' make in the word 'man'?
